positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected the agent-orchestration core (LangGraph, MCP) powering source-cited automated support across 80+ languages, with stateful multi-step pipelines, persistent memory, and a rubric-based scoring layer enforcing structured JSON responses.
Cut the effort to integrate or swap an LLM provider to a single runtime config change by building a provider-agnostic RAG layer that unifies 4 model backends (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Azure) behind one interface.
Eliminated N+1 query bottlenecks in the data layer by implementing connection pooling and batch endpoints across a full-stack platform (React, TypeScript, Express, PostgreSQL) with Stripe usage-based billing.

positions.title: Founding Engineer (Co-Founder)
positions.description:
Built and scaled a privacy app in Flutter with a serverless Firebase backend (Firestore, Auth, Storage) on GCP, securely handling 300+ early users, load-tested to support 5k+ concurrent sessions with <200ms latency.
Optimized an LLM analytics pipeline using Redis caching and async queues across 3 OpenAI models, cutting redundant calls and reducing cloud costs by 37% while improving throughput.
Led end-to-end development with CI/CD automation and QA, mentoring junior developers and accelerating feature releases by 30%, while securing Top 3 finalist out of 150+ teams at NYU Stern’s 2025 Entrepreneur Challenge with a feature in Entrepreneur Magazine.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineered the full-stack architecture for Outlook India’s news platform, (1.8M+ monthly visits) implementing in-memory caching, async REST API calls, and load balancing, reducing page load latency by 20%.
Re-designed backend services in Node.js and MongoDB, introducing compound indexes, batch updates, and parallelized queries, with automated unit tests, improving data retrieval for 20k+ student records by 30%.
Partnered with senior engineers, product managers, and designers to deliver React-based content features, improving search visibility by 15% while maintaining 99.99% uptime during breaking news traffic spikes (100k+ concurrent users).
